insurer: TATA AIG General Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.display: As per policy schedule; 10% copay if higher room taken
room_rent.note: Room eligibility category is specified in the policy schedule. If insured opts for a room higher than eligible category, 10% of admissible claim is borne by insured.

icu.note: No explicit ICU sub-limit mentioned in the wording; ICU definition present but no cap stated.

copayment.note: 10% of admissible claim if insured is admitted in a room category higher than eligible as per policy schedule. No other mandatory copay mentioned.

sub_limits.display: Ambulance ₹3,000/hosp; Health checkup ₹10,000/policy; Vaccination ₹5,000/policy; Hearing aid ₹10,000/policy
sub_limits.note: Ambulance capped at ₹3,000 per hospitalisation; health checkup 1% of SI max ₹10,000; vaccination max ₹5,000; hearing aid 50% of cost max ₹10,000; compassionate travel max ₹20,000. Core inpatient treatment appears without disease-wise sub-limits.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible mentioned in the policy wording.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses from first policy commencement; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases covered after 36 months of continuous coverage. Reducible via portability credit from prior insurer.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Extensive list of specified diseases/procedures (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.) excluded for 24 months from inception.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. No optional maternity add-on mentioned.

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% of SI added per claim-free year; max 100% of SI. On a claim, bonus reduces by 50% of SI in next year. Alternatively, a renewal premium discount (No Claim Bonus) option is available.

restoration.note: Restored SI usable for unrelated illness immediately; for related illness/same insured, available after 45 days from discharge. Not applicable for Global Cover (B13). Unutilised restored SI cannot be carried forward.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days before admission for the same condition.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days after discharge for the same condition.

day_care.note: Day care procedures covered as per list available on insurer's website; not all day-care automatically covered.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered if treatment exceeds 3 days and patient cannot be moved or no hospital room available.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient and day care treatment covered under B8; assessed per IRDAI/Ministry of AYUSH benchmark rates; only within India.

organ_donor.note: Medical and surgical expenses of organ donor for harvesting covered when insured is the recipient and inpatient claim is admitted.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance cover capped at ₹3,000 per hospitalisation for emergency or inter-hospital transfer.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatment methods including robotic surgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy (haematological), HIFU, etc. covered as part of inpatient/day care benefits.

consumables.note: Specified consumables (Annexure I List I) consumed during hospitalisation covered under B12. Personal comfort items, external durable devices excluded.

global_cover.note: Global cover (B13) for inpatient/day care abroad covered up to SI (basic SI + cumulative bonus only, not restored SI). Diagnosis must be made in India. Reimbursement basis; cashless on case-to-case basis.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years of coverage, no claim/policy contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document.

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; continuity benefits for PED, specific waiting periods, NCB, moratorium transferred.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, infertility/IVF, sleep apnoea, growth hormone therapy, alcoholic pancreatitis, external congenital anomalies, venereal diseases, dental (except accident/illness inpatient), alopecia

optional_riders.display: Accidental Death Benefit (B21); No Claim Bonus as renewal premium discount (alternative to cumulative bonus)
